description:
## Why

Half of PKIX-hbzo.1 (zlint side). `pkix-zlint-bridge` is shipped (PKIX-jy95.7.*) and exposes `ZlintBridge::run_on_cert(cert_der)` + `run_on_certs(certs_der)`. Build the thin pkix-difftest adapter that wraps the bridge as a *lint* oracle, distinct from the existing path-validation oracles in `pkix-difftest/src/oracles/`.

## What

New module `pkix-difftest/src/lint_oracles/` (NOT `oracles/` — different shape than `(chain) -> Verdict`):

- `mod.rs` — exposes `pub trait LintOracle { fn lint_cert(&self, cert_der: &[u8]) -> LintOracleResult; }`. `LintOracleResult` is `{ findings: Vec<NormalizedFinding>, oracle_error: Option<String> }` so a malformed-cert per-cert error from the bridge surfaces alongside other oracles cleanly.
- `zlint.rs` — `ZlintOracle` struct holding a `pkix_zlint_bridge::ZlintBridge`. `impl LintOracle for ZlintOracle` maps `VerdictMap` → `Vec<NormalizedFinding>` (drops NotApplicable / Pass, keeps Notice / Warn / Error / Fatal with check_id + severity).
- `pkix_lint_cabf.rs` — `PkixLintCabfOracle` wrapping `pkix_lint_cabf::cabf_tls_br::CabfTlsBrProfile` + the pkix-lint runner. Same `LintOracle` impl.

Public `NormalizedFinding { id: String, severity: pkix_lint::Severity, source: OracleSource }` is the cross-oracle vocabulary. `OracleSource` is one of `{ Zlint, Pkilint, PkixLintCabf }`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `pkix_zlint_bridge` wired as workspace dep of pkix-difftest (default-features off; only enabled when `lint-oracles` feature is on, gated behind `cfg(feature = "lint-oracles")`).
- [ ] `LintOracle` trait + `NormalizedFinding` + `OracleSource` types in `pkix-difftest/src/lint_oracles/mod.rs`.
- [ ] `ZlintOracle` impl in `lint_oracles/zlint.rs` — wraps `ZlintBridge`, maps verdicts to NormalizedFinding.
- [ ] `PkixLintCabfOracle` impl in `lint_oracles/pkix_lint_cabf.rs` — wraps the local pkix-lint-cabf TLS BR profile.
- [ ] Unit tests against tiny in-tree fixture certs (the pkix-difftest crate already has some).
- [ ] One integration test gated on real `zlint` binary present — confirms NormalizedFinding shape end-to-end.
- [ ] Module is feature-gated: `[features] lint-oracles = ["dep:pkix-zlint-bridge", "dep:pkix-lint-cabf"]`. Default features unchanged.
- [ ] `cargo build --features lint-oracles` and `cargo clippy --features lint-oracles -- -D warnings` clean.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md entry under Unreleased.

## Out of scope

- pkilint oracle (.1.2, blocked on PKIX-jy95.8).
- 3-way reconciliation logic (.1.3).
- Baseline JSON/MD generation (.1.3).
- CI workflow (.1.3).
- CA/B Forum corpus selection (.1.3).
- Touching the existing `oracles/` (chain-validation) modules.

## Depends on

- `pkix-zlint-bridge` (PKIX-jy95.7 — all 4 children closed 2026-05-12).
- `pkix-lint-cabf` (PKIX-amgn.5 closed).

## Filed by

Decomposition of PKIX-hbzo.1 (2026-05-12). Bridge-crate decision PKIX-jy95.6 means pkix-difftest consumes the shared bridge crate; this child is the consumer side for the zlint half only.
title: pkix-difftest: zlint oracle adapter (lint-domain differential)
